metadata.title: Set up your worker profile | Slashie
metadata.description: Set up your Slashie worker profile with your trade, skills, area and a verified phone, then quote on local tasks.

en.title: Set up your worker profile
en.loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again. Anything you saved is still there.
en.completeTitle: You're set up as a worker
en.completeBodyVerifyEmail: Verify your email next: you need it to send quotes.
en.saveFailed: We couldn't save this step. Try again.

about.label: About you
about.title: About you
about.description: About 5 minutes in all. Your name and photo go on your profile; your date of birth stays private.

work.label: Your work
work.title: What work do you do?
work.description: Your trade and skills lead your profile and help customers find you.

profile.label: Your profile
profile.title: Introduce yourself
profile.description: Customers read your headline and bio before they accept a quote.

area.label: Where you work
area.title: Where do you work?
area.description: Customers see your town, never your address.

phone.label: Phone
phone.title: Verify your phone
phone.description: You need a verified phone to send quotes. Customers see a Phone verified badge on your profile.

review.label: Review
review.title: Check your profile
review.description: This is how customers will see you. Change anything you like, then start quoting.

fields.dateOfBirthHelper: Private. You must be 18 or over to work on Slashie.
fields.photoHelper: A clear, friendly photo of your face. JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or AVIF, up to 5 MB.
fields.photoWrongType: Use a JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or AVIF photo.
fields.photoUploadFailed: We couldn't upload your photo. Try again.
fields.trade: What kind of work do you do most?
fields.tradeHelper: It leads your profile and suggests your skills and headline.
fields.headline: Headline
fields.headlineHelper: Shown under your name on your profile.

skills.label: Skills and services
skills.helper: Pick at least {min}, so customers can find you for the right tasks.
skills.tooShort: “{text}” is too short. Use at least {min} characters.
skills.full: That's the most skills ({max}). Remove one to add another.

qualifications.label: Qualifications and certificates
qualifications.helper: Licences or trade cards you hold. Slashie doesn't check DBS, insurance or qualifications: customers see what you write.
qualifications.tooShort: “{text}” is too short. Use at least {min} characters.
qualifications.full: That's the most qualifications ({max}). Remove one to add another.

bio.label: Short bio
bio.helper: Two or three sentences: the work you do best and why customers choose you.
bio.placeholder: What you do best, and why customers choose you
starters: The work I do best is
bio.example: I fit and repair kitchens and bathrooms across North London, with 8 years on the tools. Customers choose me for tidy work, honest quotes and turning up when I say I will. Fully insured, City & Guilds qualified.

portfolio.label: Work photos and links
portfolio.helper: Links to photos of finished jobs. Two or more work best.
portfolio.notALink: Enter a full link starting with https://
portfolio.tooLong: Use a shorter link (up to {max} characters).
portfolio.duplicate: That link is already in your portfolio.
portfolio.full: You can add up to {max} links.

area.label: Town or postcode
area.mapCaption: Customers see this approximate area on your profile.

tierDescriptions.starter: A few more details and customers will take you seriously.
tierDescriptions.good: A solid profile. A couple more details make it stand out.
tierDescriptions.allStar: Your profile has everything customers look for.

items.headline: Write a headline
items.bio: Write a bio of at least {min} characters

review.paymentsNote: Customers pay you directly for the work. Slashie doesn't handle job payments.
review.verifyEmailNote: You'll also need to verify your email before you can send quotes.

metadata.title: 設定工作者個人檔案 | Slashie
metadata.description: 設定你的 Slashie 工作者個人檔案，加入你的行業、技能、工作地區和已驗證的電話，然後為本地任務報價。

zh_hk.title: 設定你的工作者個人檔案
zh_hk.loadErrorBody: 請檢查網絡連線後再試。你已儲存的內容仍然保留。
zh_hk.completeBodyVerifyEmail: 下一步請驗證你的電郵：傳送報價前必須完成驗證。
zh_hk.saveFailed: 未能儲存這一步，請再試一次。

about.label: 關於你
about.title: 關於你
about.description: 全程大約 5 分鐘。你的名字和頭像會顯示在個人檔案；出生日期不會公開。

work.label: 你的工作
work.title: 你做哪類工作？
work.description: 你的行業和技能會顯示在個人檔案最前，幫助顧客找到你。

profile.label: 你的簡介
profile.title: 介紹你自己
profile.description: 顧客接受報價前，會先看你的標題和簡介。

area.label: 工作地區
area.title: 你在哪裡工作？
area.description: 顧客只會看到你所在的城鎮，絕不會看到你的地址。

phone.label: 電話
phone.title: 驗證你的電話
phone.description: 你需要已驗證的電話才能傳送報價。顧客會在你的個人檔案看到「電話已驗證」標記。

review.label: 檢查
review.title: 檢查你的個人檔案
review.description: 這是顧客眼中的你。你可以修改任何內容，然後開始報價。

fields.dateOfBirthHelper: 不會公開。你必須年滿 18 歲才可在 Slashie 工作。
fields.photoHelper: 清晰友善的面部相片。JPG、PNG、WebP、HEIC 或 AVIF，最大 5 MB。
fields.photoWrongType: 請使用 JPG、PNG、WebP、HEIC 或 AVIF 相片。
fields.photoTooLarge: 請使用小於 5 MB 的相片。
fields.photoUploadFailed: 未能上載你的相片，請再試一次。
fields.tradeHelper: 它會顯示在你的個人檔案最前，並為你建議技能和標題。
fields.yearsHelper: 會顯示在你的個人檔案。
fields.headline: 標題
fields.headlineHelper: 會顯示在你個人檔案的名字下方。
fields.headlinePlaceholder: 例如：8 年經驗的雜工師傅

skills.label: 技能及服務
skills.helper: 最少選擇 {min} 項，讓顧客為合適的任務找到你。
skills.tooLong: 每項技能請少於 {max} 個字元。
skills.full: 技能已達上限（{max} 項）。請先移除一項再加入。

qualifications.label: 資格及證書
qualifications.helper: 你持有的牌照或行業證。Slashie 不會核實 DBS、保險或資格：顧客會看到你填寫的內容。
qualifications.tooLong: 每項資格請少於 {max} 個字元。
qualifications.full: 資格已達上限（{max} 項）。請先移除一項再加入。

bio.label: 簡短自我介紹
bio.helper: 兩三句說明你最擅長的工作，以及顧客選擇你的原因。
bio.placeholder: 你最擅長甚麼，顧客為何選擇你
bio.example: 我在北倫敦安裝和維修廚房及浴室，已有 8 年經驗。顧客選擇我，是因為我做事整齊、報價誠實，而且準時到達。已購買保險，持有 City & Guilds 資格。

portfolio.label: 作品相片及連結
portfolio.helper: 已完成工作的相片連結。兩個或以上效果最好。
portfolio.notALink: 請輸入以 https:// 開頭的完整連結
portfolio.tooLong: 請使用較短的連結（最多 {max} 個字元）。
portfolio.duplicate: 這個連結已在你的作品集中。
portfolio.full: 最多可加入 {max} 個連結。

area.label: 城鎮或郵遞區號
area.mapCaption: 顧客會在你的個人檔案看到這個大概範圍。

tierDescriptions.starter: 再加幾項資料，顧客就會更信任你。
tierDescriptions.good: 個人檔案不錯。再加幾項資料會更突出。
tierDescriptions.allStar: 你的個人檔案已具備顧客想看的一切。
